newsitem.title: ITALY: Man hurls Molotov cocktail at Rome synagogue.
newsitem.headline: Man hurls Molotov cocktail at Rome synagogue.

text.p: A molotov cocktail was thrown at the Jewish synagogue in central Rome late on Saturday, causing slight fire damage to one door, and police said they had arrested a man who tried to flee the scene.
A spokesman for the paramilitary carabinieri police said a bottle was hurled at the building near the banks of the river Tiber at around 10 p.m. local (2100 GMT).
He said police immediately arrested the man, believed to be Middle Eastern, and were questioning him.
The AGI news agency said the man was an Egyptian known to police but the carabinieri spokesman was unable to confirm it.
Nobody was hurt in the attack and a small fire was swiftly extinguished by firemen.
"A door was slightly burned," the spokesman said.
The synagogue has been a target for attacks previously and is guarded by a permanent police presence.
A two-year-old boy died and 37 were injured in a grenade and gun attack on the building by Palestinian guerrillas in 1982.
